title: Telegram Migration & Drives
subtitle: Rust-based Telegram migration & drive platform. Two distinct workflows — can run in parallel without session conflicts.
forwarder_card_desc: Chat -> chat migration: Fast forward or Clean Copy (download + re-upload, 4-level dedupe, resume, FloodWait). Ideal for long background jobs.
drives_card_desc: Drives Workspace: browse chats, [TD] folders, video/photo/document previews, upload & download. Designed fast with multi-active account switching.
workflow_step1: 1. Connect Accounts — login Grammers, activate 1+ accounts for quick switching.
workflow_step2: 2. Forwarder — migration jobs (forward / clean copy) between chats.
sync_info: Real-time synchronization will run continuously in the background.
